title: Apply to transfer a club liquor licence
summary: If two or more registered clubs are amalgamating, this page provides information on applying to transfer a club liquor licence.
intro:
If two or more registered clubs intend to amalgamate, they need to apply for a liquor licence transfer.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: The proposed licensee (if the existing licensee consents)
Applicants must be 18 years or older
what_you_need: The liquor licence name and number
Details of the incoming licensee (transferee), including the organisation's ABN or ACN
Details of the transferee's contact person
Details of the premises owner (individual or organisation, whichever is applicable)
Signed declaration of consent from the transferor
Signed declaration of consent from the transferee
A completed direct debit request form – PDF (if operating gaming machines)
Representative's name and contact details (if applicable)
A completed appointment of manager notice form – PDF (if applicable)
Any other applicable supporting documents as noted in the Guidelines for registered clubs amalgamations
The PDF form – 'Liquor licence transfer – club licence'

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required information and documents.
Complete the PDF form – 'Liquor licence transfer – club licence'.
Email your application and pay the required fee by following the instructions on the form.

internal_links.text: appointment of manager notice form – PDF

faqs.q: Who can apply to transfer a club liquor licence?
faqs.a: The existing licensee, or the proposed licensee (if the existing licensee consents), can apply.

faqs.q: What is required if I am applying for a liquor licence transfer?
faqs.a: You must gather the liquor licence name and number, details of the incoming licensee, details of the premises owner, and signed declarations of consent from both the transferor and transferee.

faqs.q: Where can I find the necessary forms?
faqs.a: The required PDF form is 'Liquor licence transfer – club licence', which can be found here: https://www.nsw.gov.au/business-and-economy/liquor-and-gaming/liquor-licensing/resources/club-licence-forms
